name: atomic-artifact-writes
title: Write generated artifacts atomically to end the regeneration read race
description: Continuous regeneration rewrites CSV/log artifacts in place (delete + rewrite) outside the generation lock while HTTP reader threads serve those files, so a client reading /v1/logs/stream or a component CSV during a --continuous-generate cycle can observe a truncated or momentarily-missing file. Introduce atomic write (temp + os.replace) and coordinate the log-stream reader.
creator: sdelmas
